design.instructions: Which alternative best preserves the verified original deferred SEND meaning and required security while completing this finite runtime gap? Evaluate all alternatives against the same listed controls, distinguish a source-authorized internal guard read from a user read grant, and select keep_refusal if authority or live-model semantics remain unresolved.

criteria.caller_read: Provide authentic retained initiating-principal re-admission and original current viewer grants; preserve guard null actor separately. Avoid internal owner-read authority but adds a durable principal binding; requires genuine producer evidence, never infer from createdBy/account.
criteria.guard_owner_read: Define the narrow installed source-owner read association for exact original verified Bool SEND guard only, using genuine declared model/containment/ref identity and same physical owner/checkpoint/current Identity; no user-visible row or raw port, no metadata-granted authority. Validate current target/ancestor facts in source order and before claim. Preserve null actor and explicit run.account membership subject. Adds finite guard reader contract.
criteria.keep_refusal: Keep unsupported navigation fail-closed until source/authorization or live-model semantics are explicitly determined; exact current inputs insufficient for either safe association. Preserves safety but does not complete original runtime exit; name missing contract without an entire-plan gate.
